prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return strict TypeScript module solution.ts.
Required API: export function alternatingEnds(input: string): string | null
Behavior: Parse a non-empty comma-separated list of canonical signed decimal integers in -1000..1000. Return values by taking leftmost, rightmost, next-leftmost, next-rightmost until exhausted, joined by commas. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: 1,2,3,4,5 returns 1,5,2,4,3.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: const nums=(s:string):number[]|null=>{if(!s)return null;let o=[];for(const z of s.split(',')){if(!/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(z))return null;let x=Number(z);if(x< -1000||x>1000)return null;o.push(x)}return o};export function alternatingEnds(s:string):string|null{let a=nums(s);if(!a)return null;let o=[],i=0,j=a.length-1;while(i<=j){o.push(a[i++]);if(i<=j)o.push(a[j--])}return o.join(',')}
